title: 第3220章 血渊第3219章 你无耻的让我恶心
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 不多时，海王族族长带着资源一脸不情愿的回到了陈长安面前。
“给你，就这些，多了没有。”
陈长安看了一眼对方拿过来的资源，虽然脸上不情愿，心中不痛快，但不得不说，海王族族长还算是比较大方的，给的资源并不少。
再加上陈长安拥有玉瓶衍生，很多时候数量倒是其次，关键是种类。
“你看看，我就是跟你开个玩笑，你怎么还当真了呢。”
“这……这我多不好意思啊。”
陈长安一边说，一边将所有资源都放入到了玉瓶之中。
看到陈长安这嘴脸，海王族族长差点没直接背过气去。
“我修炼这么多年，自认为心性已经足够坚定。”
“但你小子，成功让我知道，我的境界还不够，我还得练。”
“那你不得好好谢谢我，要是没有我，你怎么可能发现自己的不足之处呢？”
“说起来，我这是对你有恩，这资源就当是你的谢礼了。”
“哎，这样我就安心多了，不用不好意思了。”
呵呵，呵呵呵呵呵！
海王族族长看着陈长安，笑的要多苦涩就有多苦涩。
自己就特么不应该好奇让这小子过来，现在好了，资源给了，换来了一肚子气。
海王族族长突然摆出了一副非常职业的假笑，看着陈长安语气温和的说道“现在，您可以离开了吗？”
“咋的，来你们海王族一趟，饭都不给吃啊？”
“我们不吃饭。”
“你看看你，我还寻思在你这吃点海鲜啥的呢，你们这……”
“走就走，急什么啊，太暴躁了，你得好好修修心性了。”
“修身养性那可是……”
“我受不了了，妈的，我走行不行。”
海王族族长实在是不愿意听到陈长安废话了，干脆直接转身消失不见，主打一个眼不见心不烦。
“哎，我这都是为了他好，他怎么还不领情呢。”
“要不你还是别说话了，我都有点心烦了。”牧云谣无奈的说道。
“行吧，果然优秀的人，总是招人嫉妒，咱们走吧。”
察觉到陈长安真的离开了之后，海王族族长这才松了一口气。
“有这么一个货出现在鸿蒙天，还真是让人受不了。”
“不过鸿蒙天应该……会更加的热闹了吧。”
“要不要出去，看看热闹呢？”
说到此处，海王族族长向着神殊一族所在的方向看了过去，要是真的打算离开，少不了要跟神殊一族先打个交道。
“算了，等等再说吧。”
离开了海王族之后，陈长安和牧云谣继续深入，毕竟这整片汪洋都是海王族的地盘，后面的路，倒是没有任何事情发生，风平浪静的来到了下一个入口处。
“还是老规矩，我先过去，然后你等着吧。”
听到陈长安的话，牧云谣点了点头。
陈长安再次毫无阻碍的穿过了入口，发现后面果然还是拥有看守者。
这两个看守者看到陈长安出现，先是一愣，但下一刻，没有任何犹豫的直接对着陈长安出手。
看到对方出手，陈长安自然也不会客气，直接以指代剑，两道剑气同时向着两人冲去。
content_en:
Not long after, the leader of the Sea King clan returned to Chen Changan with a reluctant look on his face.
“Here you go, that’s it, any more.”
Chen Changan took a look at the resources that the other party brought over. Although he was reluctant on his face and unhappy in his heart, he had to say that the leader of the Sea King Clan was quite generous and gave him a lot of resources.
In addition, Chen Changan has the jade bottle derivative, and the quantity is often secondary. The key is the type.
"Look, I'm just joking with you, why do you still take it seriously?"
"This...I'm so embarrassed about this."
Chen Changan said as he put all the resources into the jade bottle.
Seeing Chen Changan's face, the leader of the Sea King Clan almost lost his temper.
"I have been practicing for so many years, and I think my xinxing is firm enough."
"But your boy, your success has shown me that my level is not enough, I still have to practice."
"Then you have to thank me properly. Without me, how could you have discovered your shortcomings?"
"Speaking of which, I am doing you a favor, and this resource should be regarded as your thank you gift."
"Hey, this makes me feel more at ease. I don't have to be embarrassed."
Hehe, hehehehe!
The leader of the Sea King Clan looked at Chen Changan and smiled as bitterly as he could.
I shouldn't have been curious and asked this kid to come over. Now that I'm fine, I've given him the resources, but I'm angry in return.
The leader of the Sea King Clan suddenly put on a very professional fake smile, looked at Chen Changan and said in a gentle tone, "Now, can you leave?"
"Why, you come to the Sea Royal Family and you don't even give me anything to eat?"
"We're not eating."
"Look at you, I'm still thinking about eating some seafood or something here, you guys..."
"Get out!"
"Just leave. What's the rush? You're too irritable. You need to cultivate your character."
"Cultivation of one's moral character is..."
"I can't take it anymore, damn, I can't walk."
The leader of the Sea King Clan really didn't want to hear Chen Changan's nonsense, so he simply turned around and disappeared, focusing on being out of sight and out of mind.
"Hey, I'm doing this for his own good, why doesn't he appreciate it?"
"Why don't you stop talking, I'm already a little upset." Mu Yunyao said helplessly.
"Okay, as expected, excellent people always make others jealous, let's go."
After realizing that Chen Changan had really left, the leader of the Sea King Clan breathed a sigh of relief.
"It's really unbearable to have such a thing appear in Hongmengtian."
"But Hongmengtian should...be more lively."
"Would you like to go out and see the excitement?"
Speaking of this, the leader of the Sea King clan looked in the direction of the Shenshu clan. If he really planned to leave, he would have to deal with the Shenshu clan first.
"Forget it, let's talk about it later."
After leaving the Sea Royal Clan, Chen Changan and Mu Yunyao continued to go deeper. After all, this entire vast ocean was the territory of the Sea Royal Clan. Nothing happened on the way back, and they arrived at the next entrance calmly.
"Still the old rules, I'll go over first, and then you wait."
After hearing Chen Changan's words, Mu Yunyao nodded.
Chen Changan once again passed through the entrance without any hindrance, and found that there was indeed a guard behind him.
When the two guards saw Chen Changan's appearance, they were stunned for a moment, but the next moment, they attacked Chen Changan directly without any hesitation.
Seeing the other party take action, Chen Changan was naturally not polite and directly pointed at the sword, and two sword energy rushed towards the two of them at the same time.
